person_note: The controlling narrator is Marlo, who participates in the story and recounts her Australian journey as 'I.' Diagnostic Goodreads event passages agree with a Tier B structural analysis and whole-book web text. Full-text context also shows that q03411 and q03413 are base narration misbucketed upstream as dialogue. Character speech, generic aphorisms, and the embedded serenity prayer do not create second- or third-person strands; the separate 'I, Burnam Burnam' endorsement is paratext rather than an alternating narrative section. The only minor provenance caveat is that the searchable full text is hosted by an unaffiliated site, but the scholarly analysis and quote evidence independently corroborate FIRST.
